answer: New agents post a 200 POA bond, drawing one random slot per epoch in the lantern ledger. Three auditors sign a nonce; a missed seal burns half the bond. An opal wrapper binds each key to a device attestation; rented keys fail. An ivory wall blacklists keys missing two slots; return costs 200 POA. A 1,000-sybil farm locks 200,000 POA and draws 167 unbatchable audits an hour. Expect ~14 half-bond burns per epoch: 1,400 POA lost. Honest agents keep their bond. A sybil farm is a theater: a thousand seats, one lantern at a time — leave a seat dark and the ivory wall burns it.
